notes.title: Egglien Update 1.1!
notes.notes:
Hey all!

Egglien's got a fresh new update with steam achievements plus loads of fixes.

The achievements can easily be done in the first two worlds which is [b]perfect for another 100% on your steam library... [/b]

I'm starting to close the door on the game itself, though I wouldn't turn anyway just yet, there's still a couple more Eggtastic surprises lurking around the corner waiting for it to reveal itself ːsteammockingː

Enjoy!!! 

Alfie.
